items.author: ScriptWidget Community
items.name: Gallery Hello Card
items.summary: A polished offline starter that demonstrates a responsive Gallery install.

items.author: ScriptWidget Community
items.name: Privacy Review
items.summary: Review a widget for minimal data access and clear fallbacks.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Countdown
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.3. A calm countdown with saved dates, yearly repeats and three accent colors. Configure it in Records & Configuration or use a date parameter.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: GitHub Repo Stats
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.3. Public GitHub repository counts with saved configuration, bounded cache and clear offline/rate-limit states.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Habit Heatmap
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.3. Tap to check in each day. Local saved history powers a calendar heatmap and streak for Read, Run and Meditate. Interactive widgets require iOS 17+ or macOS 14+.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Habit Streak Tracker
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.3. Explicit daily check-ins with a real streak, recent history, reset and undo. Earlier automatic counters remain untouched.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Health Steps Ring
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.3. Read-only HealthKit steps, active energy or latest heart rate, with saved goals and clear unavailable states.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Hydration Goal
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.3. Log real water intake with a configurable glass size, seven-day history, reset and undo.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Local Weather (Location)
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.3. MET Norway forecasts with a saved-city fallback, response-aware cache and Celsius/Fahrenheit. Configure a city in Records & Configuration.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Mood Check-in
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.3. Save a daily mood with a personal intention, seven-day history, reset and undo.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Packing Checklist
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.3. Check off a configurable daily packing list with saved history, reset and undo.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Photo Card
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.3. Import and crop your own photos, then make a single card, duo or four-photo collage. Photos stay in the widget package.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Plant Care
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.3. Local explicit daily care with saved history, undo and original JSX artwork.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Pocket Pet
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.3. Local explicit daily care with saved history, undo and original JSX artwork.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Quick Launcher
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.3. Save and reorder web links, app URLs and named Shortcuts. Test draft links in Records & Configuration.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Wallpaper Match
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.4. Calibrate crops from your own wallpaper, separately for each size and appearance. Optional title, caption and date.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Weather Now (MET Norway)
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.3. MET Norway forecasts with a saved-city fallback, response-aware cache and Celsius/Fahrenheit. Configure a city in Records & Configuration.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Photo Album Rotator
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.4. Rotate bounded snapshots from photos and albums explicitly selected in Settings.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Reminders Agenda
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.4. Reminders due today from selected lists, with an explicit Complete next action.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Health Overview
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.4. Read-only sleep, real activity rings and bounded workout summaries. No readings are saved.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: GitHub Profile
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.4. Your authenticated GitHub profile and repository counts, with explicit per-widget account access.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Music Playback
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.4. A read-only snapshot of the iOS Music app, with honest permission, platform and missing-metadata states. Web Studio uses editable samples.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Layout Starter
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.0. A literal JSX canvas for the shared native/Web Layout editor. Select layers, change text and properties, reorder and undo without replacing your JavaScript.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Material Study
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.4. Original shapes behind a public frosted material card with a static 3D tilt and accessibility fallbacks.

items.author: ScriptWidget
items.name: Hydration Goal iCloud
items.summary: Requires Runtime API 1.5. An opt-in iCloud hydration example with timestamped taps and additive offline merging. Limited by the iCloud JSON revision budget.
